newsitem.title: USA: Nature's Sunshine stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Nature's Sunshine stake held by group.

text.p: Greenwich, Conn.,-based investment managers Thomas Smith and Thomas Tryforos said on Tuesday they hold a 7.4 percent stake in Nature's Sunshine Products Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Smith and Tryforos said they hold 1,397,267 common shares of Nature's Sunshine for investment purposes.

The bulk -- 1,291,245 shares -- were purchased between September 26 and November 15 at prices ranging from $17 to $23.77 a share or about $28.5 million. The shares were purchased on behalf of managed accounts, they said.
The rest are their personal holdings purchased for about $1.2 million, they said.
Nature's Sunshine is a Provo, Utah-based maker and marketer of encapsulated herbs and vitamins.
